risks.title: Unfavorable real estate market conditions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the 'RESULTS OF OPERATIONS' and 'HOMEBUILDING Financial Results' sections. The language used ('challenging', 'softer demand', 'affordability challenges', 'elevated mortgage loan interest rates') indicates significant severity. Year-over-year comparisons show revenue and profit declines, highlighting deterioration. The Macroeconomic category is weighted as it directly affects core business.

risks.title: Decline in selling prices and gross margins
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in 'RESULTS OF OPERATIONS' and 'HOMEBUILDING Financial Results', with quantified data ('average selling price of net orders was down 6%', 'housing gross profit margin for 2025 was 18.6% compared to 21.0% for 2024'). Language intensity is moderate but figures are clear. Margin decline directly impacts profitability, justifying high severity in the Industrial category.

risks.title: Increase in selling, general and administrative expenses
risks.score_rationale: This risk is identified in 'RESULTS OF OPERATIONS' and 'HOMEBUILDING Financial Results' ('selling, general and administrative expenses as a percentage of housing revenues... increased 40 basis points'). Language is factual but the increase is highlighted as a factor contributing to operating margin decline. The Industrial category is relevant as these costs relate to operations.

risks.title: Decrease in net orders and order value
risks.score_rationale: This risk is quantified in 'RESULTS OF OPERATIONS' ('net orders in 2025 decreased 11% year over year', 'value of our net orders for 2025 was down 17%'). Language intensity is moderate but the significant decline in orders directly impacts future revenue. The Macroeconomic category is appropriate as it reflects overall market demand.

risks.title: Interest rate and affordability risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in 'RESULTS OF OPERATIONS' as a demand-limiting factor ('affordability challenges and persistently elevated mortgage loan interest rates'). Language is direct and emphasizes impact on 'pool of actionable buyers'. Severity is high as interest rates are a key driver of real estate markets. Macroeconomic category applies.

risks.title: Inventory charges and land impairment
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in 'HOMEBUILDING Financial Results' with precise figures ('total inventory-related charges of $32.1 million and $4.6 million, respectively'). Language intensity is factual but the impact on gross margin is significant. The Industrial category is relevant as it concerns real estate asset management.

ai_positioning.summary: KBH does not reference artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
